crossRefs.note: Yahweh was sorry that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him in his heart.
They put away the foreign gods from among them and served Yahweh; and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.
How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!
But they rebelled and grieved his Holy Spirit. Therefore he turned and became their enemy, and he himself fought…
When he had looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their hearts, he said to the man…
Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there might be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the…
and might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn’t make their hearts…
They also reel with wine, and stagger with strong drink. The priest and the prophet reel with strong drink. They are…
My people consult with their wooden idol, and answer to a stick of wood. Indeed the spirit of prostitution has led them…
This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for…
For everyone who does evil hates the light, and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.
But because I tell the truth, you don’t believe me.
Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are…
and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth…
That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,
Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, “It is a people that errs in their heart. They have not…
He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise Yah!
“For my people are foolish. They don’t know me. They are foolish children, and they have no understanding. They are…
For if the truth of God through my lie abounded to his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?

translations.web: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘They always err in their heart, but they didn’t know my ways.’
translations.bsb: Therefore I was angry with that generation, and I said, ‘Their hearts are always going astray, and they have not known My ways.’
translations.kjv: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do alway err in their heart; and they have not known my ways.
translations.asv: Wherefore I was displeased with this generation, And said, They do always err in their heart: But they did not know my ways;
